text: I can't see the live betting engine from here: it runs on your phone, and today only the bets it places are uploaded, not its decisions (what it judged, the score and clock behind each price, offers, bids and why it passed). I'm building the logger now: a journal of every judgment, offer and bid with the game state, uploaded to GitHub every 15 minutes like your bet history, so I can check whether it buys real mispricings and whether the bids are safe. It ships in the next build; use the Live tab as normal after updating and I'll read it after a few games.
